research_pack.summary: IIM Kashipur offers full-time residential MBA and MBA (Analytics) programmes, alongside Executive MBA and Executive MBA (Analytics) programmes. The MBA (Analytics) is a two-year, six-term residential programme featuring core management/analytics courses, electives, a summer internship, and a dissertation. The Executive MBA (Analytics) is a two-year, six-term blended learning programme for working professionals, requiring a bachelor's degree (min 45% marks) and 3 years of full-time work experience. Executive MBA fees total ₹12,00,000 over two years (₹6,60,000 for year one; ₹5,40,000 for year two). The institute facilitates student exchange programmes with various international partner universities. Admissions, selection criteria, and placement details are managed through the institute's academic and placement offices.

working at different levels, is an important constituent of the offerings at IIM Kashipur. These Management development programs(MDPs) are structured keeping in mind the changing global business environment and international standards which help in developing the skills and competencies of the participants. Our programs are designed for Specialised areas like business policy, finance, accounting, organisational behaviour, marketing, industrial and personal relations, quantitative and production methods, information systems and computers, health, public systems, agriculture and education. We offer two types of MDPs: Open MDPs: These programmes are in the nature of 'open-enrolment' courses, usually 2-5 days in duration with participation open to all practicing/experienced managers and/or executives. Customised MDPs: We also offer exclusive custom-designed programmes, to address specific Executive Learning and/or Corporate Training mandates from individual organisations. Under this format, courses are designed in collaboration with the client organisation, and scheduled at a mutually convenient date and venue. Such programmes can be domain-specific as in Sales & Marketing, Operations, Finance, Strategy, Leadership, etc. or inter-disciplinary, involving an optimal mix of multiple functional areas. Enter your details × Name: Email Moblie Number Organization ↻ The MBA (Analytics) at IIM Kashipur is a two-year, full-time residential program meticulously crafted to build a strong foundation in both management principles and advanced data analytics. Designed for future leaders in the analytics domain, the curriculum offers a structured and progressive learning journey that seamlessly integrates theoretical frameworks with practical application. First-Year Structure The first year is organized into three academic terms and comprises exclusively mandatory core courses. These courses span key functional areas of management and analytics, equipping students with essential knowledge and skills that serve as the bedrock for advanced study. Upon completion of the first-year coursework, students undertake an 8–10 week summer internship, providing immersive exposure to real-world business challenges and an opportunity to apply classroom learning in a professional environment. Second-Year Structure The second year is divided into three terms (IV, V, and VI) and features a blend of mandatory analytics courses, a diverse selection of electives, and a comprehensive dissertation component. Students have the flexibility to customize their academic path by selecting electives aligned with their interests and career goals. The dissertation, conducted across all three terms of the second year, allows students to engage in deep, independent research on a topic of personal or professional relevance. This capstone project fosters critical thinking and analytical rigor, guiding students through the process of problem definition, application of analytical methodologies, and synthesis of insights—skills that are indispensable in today’s data-centric business landscape. This process helps students in the following manner: Easy and speedy process to deliver transcripts to receiving overseas Universities where student might have applied for studies Students need not visit NMIMS University for making an application for transcript and payment of fees.
